title: AFsample3: Generating and selecting multiple conformational states with Alphafold3
excerpt: Accurately capturing the conformational diversity of proteins is essential for understanding their mechanisms and functions. We present AFsample3 to generate and select diverse conformational states using AlphaFold3.
citation: Kalakoti, Y., Korsunsky, A. M., Wallner, B. (2026). "AFsample3: Generating and selecting multiple conformational states with Alphafold3." bioRxiv.

title: AFsample2 predicts multiple conformations and ensembles with AlphaFold2
excerpt: AFsample2 is an enhanced sampling pipeline for AlphaFold2 that predicts multiple protein conformations and structural ensembles across diverse protein targets.
citation: Kalakoti, Y., Wallner, B. (2025). "AFsample2 predicts multiple conformations and ensembles with AlphaFold2." Communications Biology. 8(1), 373.

title: Prediction of structural variation
excerpt: A comprehensive review of recent advances in computational structural biology for predicting conformational changes, alternative states, and structural ensembles in proteins.
citation: Kalakoti, Y., Sanjeev, A., Wallner, B. (2025). "Prediction of structural variation." Current Opinion in Structural Biology. 91, 103003.

title: Estimating protein–ligand interactions with geometric deep learning and mixture density models
excerpt: Presents a geometric deep learning approach coupled with mixture density networks to estimate protein-ligand binding interactions and affinities.
citation: Eliot, Kalakoti, Y., Gawande, S., Sundar, D. (2024). "Estimating protein–ligand interactions with geometric deep learning and mixture density models." Journal of Biosciences. 49(4), 97.

title: Identifying High-Quality Leads among Screened Anticancerous Compounds Using SMILES Representations
excerpt: Introduces deep learning workflows using SMILES representations to identify high-quality lead candidates from chemical libraries screened against cancer targets.
citation: Kalakoti, Y., Malik, V., Sundar, D. (2024). "Identifying High-Quality Leads among Screened Anticancerous Compounds Using SMILES Representations." ACS Omega. 9(27), 29740-29750.

title: M-Ionic: prediction of metal-ion-binding sites from sequence using residue embeddings
excerpt: M-Ionic predicts metal-ion-binding sites in proteins directly from sequence representations and residue embeddings with high precision.
citation: Shenoy, A., Kalakoti, Y., Sundar, D., Elofsson, A. (2024). "M-Ionic: prediction of metal-ion-binding sites from sequence using residue embeddings." Bioinformatics. 40(1), btad782.

title: Modulation of DNA-protein Interactions by Proximal Genetic Elements as Uncovered by Interpretable Deep Learning
excerpt: Employs interpretable deep learning architectures to discover how proximal genetic elements modulate DNA-protein binding affinity and transcriptional control.
citation: Kalakoti, Y., Peter, S. C., Gawande, S., Sundar, D. (2023). "Modulation of DNA-protein Interactions by Proximal Genetic Elements as Uncovered by Interpretable Deep Learning." Journal of Molecular Biology. 435(13), 168121.

title: Computational Methods and Deep Learning for Elucidating Protein Interaction Networks
excerpt: Comprehensive guide and protocol detailing computational pipelines and deep learning models for uncovering and mapping protein-protein interaction networks.
citation: Vora, D. S., Kalakoti, Y., Sundar, D. (2022). "Computational Methods and Deep Learning for Elucidating Protein Interaction Networks." Methods in Molecular Biology. Vol 2553, 285-323.

title: Genome Sequence of a Potent Biosurfactant-Producing Bacterium, Franconibacter sp. Strain IITDAS19
excerpt: Reports the complete genome assembly and functional annotation of Franconibacter sp. IITDAS19, highlighting biosurfactant synthesis pathways.
citation: Sharma, J., Kalakoti, Y., Srivastava, P., Sundar, D. (2022). "Genome Sequence of a Potent Biosurfactant-Producing Bacterium, Franconibacter sp. Strain IITDAS19." Microbiology Resource Announcements. 11(8), e00419-22.

title: Deep Neural Network-Assisted Drug Recommendation Systems for Identifying Potential Drug–Target Interactions
excerpt: Investigates deep neural network architectures for drug recommendation by predicting novel drug-target interactions across high-throughput datasets.
citation: Kalakoti, Y., Yadav, S., Sundar, D. (2022). "Deep Neural Network-Assisted Drug Recommendation Systems for Identifying Potential Drug–Target Interactions." ACS Omega. 7(14), 12138-12146.

title: TransDTI: Transformer-Based Language Models for Estimating DTIs and Building a Drug Recommendation Workflow
excerpt: Introduces TransDTI, leveraging transformer protein language models and chemical representations for drug-target interaction prediction and automated drug recommendation.
citation: Kalakoti, Y., Yadav, S., Sundar, D. (2022). "TransDTI: Transformer-Based Language Models for Estimating DTIs and Building a Drug Recommendation Workflow." ACS Omega. 7(3), 2706-2717.

title: SurvCNN: A Discrete Time-to-Event Cancer Survival Estimation Framework Using Image Representations of Omics Data
excerpt: Proposes SurvCNN, an image-based representation framework using convolutional neural networks for time-to-event cancer survival modeling from multi-omics data.
citation: Kalakoti, Y., Yadav, S., Sundar, D. (2021). "SurvCNN: A Discrete Time-to-Event Cancer Survival Estimation Framework Using Image Representations of Omics Data." Cancers. 13(13), 3106.

title: Deep learning assisted multi-omics integration for survival and drug-response prediction in breast cancer
excerpt: Integrates multi-omics profiles with deep neural networks to accurately predict patient survival and clinical drug response in breast cancer cohorts.
citation: Malik, V., Kalakoti, Y., Sundar, D. (2021). "Deep learning assisted multi-omics integration for survival and drug-response prediction in breast cancer." BMC Genomics. 22(1), 214.

title: Multi-omics Integration based Predictive Model for Survival Prediction of Lung Adenocarcinoma
excerpt: Develops a feature-selected multi-omics integration pipeline utilizing machine learning classifiers for overall survival prediction in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD).
citation: Malik, V., Dutta, S., Kalakoti, Y., Sundar, D. (2019). "Multi-omics Integration based Predictive Model for Survival Prediction of Lung Adenocarcinoma." 2019 Grace Hopper Celebration India (GHCI). IEEE.
